svg.text: Updated from your paper sketches. Black drops carry the player left. Wedge face angles produce physical rebounds into an upper catcher.
Orange: lethal hazards. Mint: bouncy wedges. Purple: vortex pull boundary. White: collectible stars.
Select a Mektra_level_N group to inspect/edit; its background preserves the exact 390 x 1080 export size.
Land on the rain. Jump again before it carries you off the left edge.
Rebound from the wedge faces. The upper landing catches your exit.
